description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5935016990620 CONNECTOR,PLUG,ELEC: Line 0001 Qty 896 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0044 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
